_producer.why: A stale background process can overwrite a corrected artifact, and then a later reader cannot tell which version of the reasoning produced the numbers. The 2026-09-29 run of this very script did exactly that: an earlier revision wrote full_param={'fp32_adamw_gib': 8.94, 'fits': True} by comparing weights+grads+optimizer against the card while ignoring activations, and a corrected re-run had to overwrite it. Recording the producer lets the audit detect that the artifact and the script disagree.

_timing_variation.note: Step time is not reproducible to two decimals on this host. Three runs of this probe gave 1.28/1.31/1.34 s/step. The manuscript therefore quotes ~1.3 s/step, and the audit checks the timing with a tolerance covering this spread. Quoting 1.31 as a two-digit fact would be a claim about precision the measurement does not support.

_revisions: rev 1 (superseded): compared fp32 weights+grads+AdamW against the card with ACTIVATIONS OMITTED, giving 8.94 GiB and fits=true. Wrong: activations are a real term, and the seed is 751.6M not 0.6B.
rev 2 (current): 751.6M params, activations included -> 13.26 GiB, fits=false. LoRA peak 7.80 GiB.
